About.title: about
About.statement:
In my work, I explore emotional states and attempt to make tensions and atmosphere visible. By painting over, blurring, and deliberately leaving forms open, I create visual spaces that invite viewers to interpret the surfaces through their own associations and memories. 
At the heart of my current series is freedom in relationships—translated into fragile pictorial structures. The constant shift between control and dissolution plays a central role here. The works are shaped by an exploration of boundaries, expectations, and projections. They emerge from multilayered traces and overlays created using natural pigments.
